verdict.rationale: Trilegal is a full-service Indian law firm, a professional-services business rather than a software product or service that exposes an API. A downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is a category error for this kind of product. The llms.txt file only makes website content machine-readable and is not an API spec, and probes found no OpenAPI files, so nothing shows the firm ships an API that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
